system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Teguh Bestari Medical Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000640)
Industry: Healthcare | State: Sabah | Status: Active
Business: Dental clinic and orthodontic services
Incorporated: 1988-10-17 | Share capital: RM100,000
Board: 2 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 63.9% (also a director)
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-12-31)
FY2022: revenue RM1.07m, profit after tax RM80,085, equity RM488,099, operating cash flow RM160,579, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM1.09m, profit after tax RM89,803, equity RM550,961, operating cash flow RM150,659, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM1.16m, profit after tax RM90,125, equity RM614,048, operating cash flow RM168,772, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 6 total (1 as defendant, 5 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 1
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [HIGH] 1 open case(s) against the company (pending or judgment entered), claims totalling RM310,600, of which 1 already at judgment, equal to 51% of equity (RM614,048).
response: Teguh Bestari Medical Sdn. Bhd. is a Sabah-based healthcare company incorporated in 1988 that provides dental clinic and orthodontic services. There is 1 high-risk signal: 1 open case against the company with claims totalling RM310,600, of which 1 is already at judgment, equal to 51% of equity (RM614,048). Additional context includes 5 court cases brought as plaintiff and 2 directors, with the largest holding 63.9%. Latest financial figures from FY2024 (year end 2024-12-31) show revenue of RM1.16m, profit after tax of RM90,125, equity of RM614,048, operating cash flow of RM168,772, and an unqualified audit.
